query.text: declare @key2 nvarchar(3000) select @key2 = @lookupKey + case when @val = '' then '' else ' and (@@fieldKey like N''' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@val) + '%'' or @@fieldName like N''' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@val) + '%'')' end exec ISWIFTStoreTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join vdmcangdi d on a.ma_noi_di = d.ma_noi_di left join vdmcangden e on a.ma_noi_den = e.ma_noi_den left join dmkh f on a.ma_kh = f.ma_kh left join vdmhangtau k on a.ma_hang = k.ma_hang', 'd.ten_noi_di,e.ten_noi_den, f.ten_kh, k.ten_hang', N'@@key', @key2, @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 10, @@admin, @@userId
